task.title: P6-143: Make the needs empty state reachable by navigation
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Needs, shopping and pull). Original id: P6-143. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`/needs`' empty state is unreachable by navigation** (was `P6-049i`). `/my/collections/:id/needs` is linked **only** from the needs chip (`collection.rs:742-754`), which renders only when the chip is `Some` — which is exactly when nothing is missing and the empty state would show.
